title: Email/copy: onSuccessUpdateOriginal unimplemented but doc says supported
description: email.rs handle_email_copy doc comment says 'Supports onSuccessDestroyOriginal and onSuccessUpdateOriginal' but the handler never reads or acts on onSuccessUpdateOriginal. A client that sends onSuccessUpdateOriginal gets silent no-op. RFC 8620 §6.3 requires it. Fix: implement onSuccessUpdateOriginal or remove it from the doc comment and add an unsupported note.
